This comparison examines extra echocardiography codes in the Sygesikringsregisteret (the National Health Service Register), specifically focusing on three procedure codes used to register echocardiography procedures. The data provides a static snapshot of how these codes are described in the registry, rather than tracking quantitative performance, targets, or longitudinal trends.

The registry lists three distinct codes for this procedure. Code [[6402-ekkocardiografi|6402 Ekkocardiografi]] is described simply as "Ekkocardiografi" [^src1]. Similarly, code [[6408-ekkocardiografi|6408 Ekkocardiografi]] carries the exact same description of "Ekkocardiografi" [^src1]. The third code, [[0906-ekko-kardiografi|0906 Ekko-kardiografi]], features a slight spelling variation with a hyphen, described as "Ekko-kardiografi" [^src1]. Ultimately, all three of these codes refer to echocardiography without any further clinical or procedural specification [^src1]. Because the evidence consists of a single dated section, no trends, improvements, or declines can be assessed.
